source.name: 2026 AIA Swim & Dive Qualifier Information
source.generator: manual (verified directly against page 3 of the source program PDF; no extraction script)
source.notes: Arizona Interscholastic Association high-school state-qualifying automatic cuts, transcribed from the 'AIA STATE CHAMPIONSHIP 2026 Qualifying Standards' table printed on page 3 of the Higley Knights Spooktacular meet program. One cut per gender/event/division -- no age dimension, no course dimension (AIA meets run SCY only), and no next-tier bonus layering like AZSI: a swimmer either meets their division's single cut or doesn't. This REPLACES the USA-S motivational tiers for a meet that opts into it, rather than layering on top like AZSI does. The table's 'Diving (11 dives)' row is a judged score, not a time, and is not included -- this app does not track diving.
